verdict.rationale: GitBook documents adding an OpenAPI specification to build API reference content (docs-23), with interactive blocks that let users test endpoints on the page (docs-35, docs-5). The evidence only shows these feature titles and snippets, though: nothing confirms that pages are auto-generated from the spec or that they stay in sync when the spec changes. Missing for 10: evidence of automatic re-sync or refresh when the spec updates (e.g. URL polling or CI/CLI push), detail on how pages are generated from the spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
